name: bm-codex-usage-monitor
description: A compact Codex usage indicator for the VS Code status bar.

codexUsageMonitor.statusBar.displayWindo.description: Choose which Codex usage windows appear in the status bar.

codexUsageMonitor.statusBar.fiveHourWarn.description: Warning threshold for the five-hour remaining usage, in percent (0–100). The status bar turns orange below this value.

codexUsageMonitor.statusBar.fiveHourCrit.description: Critical threshold for the five-hour remaining usage, in percent (0–100). The status bar turns red below this value.

codexUsageMonitor.statusBar.weeklyWarnin.description: Warning threshold for weekly remaining usage, in percent (0–100). The status bar turns orange below this value.

codexUsageMonitor.statusBar.weeklyCritic.description: Critical threshold for weekly remaining usage, in percent (0–100). The status bar turns red below this value.
